summary_en: A cyclist rides through a park under MAKE IT MOVE IT title slams, printed as three misregistered riso ink plates with halftone screens.
limits_en: The 6.5 s whole-plate misregistration kick and every title slam show up as jump frames in deliver.py: by design. Their frame numbers move when you change the beats.
The cyclist is an assembly of geometric pieces, without the street buildings that A has.
